project_scope: On-call consultant services for parks and recreation projects, providing design support and structural engineering for larger capital projects and one-time engineering needs. services: On-call structural engineering and multidisciplinary design support services for parks and recreation projects; may include structural design, civil engineering, inspections, feasibility studies, cost estimating, geotechnical engineering, traffic design, and rehabilitation-related support.
relevance_explanation:
- General on-call framework without a defined technically demanding structure.
- Focus is parks and recreation support rather than a specific bridge, roof, stadium, tower, or complex building.
- Includes structural engineering, but mixed with many non-core disciplines.
- Rehabilitation/refurbishment and feasibility components reduce relevance for sbp.
- Could offer occasional structural tasks, but strategic fit is weak due to lack of defined scope.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. The notice is for on-call consulting services only, with no defined project size, construction volume, or individual capital project budget.
fee_explanation: No consultant fee or contract value is stated in the tender notice. As an on-call framework with undefined task orders, no realistic fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
